primary_evidence.section: Contents of a B3D File; ProcessingPassType
primary_evidence.finding: Kinematics, low-pass filter and dynamics passes are separately retained. Position 1 is not an assured dynamics pass; trial pass availability may differ.
Read exact trial length in bounded requests; frame t is trial-local frame index. Out-of-bounds reads may return empty arrays.
Vectors resolve in model root coordinates, not automatically anatomical forward/lateral or vertical. Contact-body order is obtained from source metadata, not assumed right-first.
Quality flags and actual pass type must accompany raw arrays. DOF indices require model-specific mapping; generalized forces are not all implicitly joint moments.

concrete_old_defects: Hard-coded pass slot 1 interpreted as dynamics.
Fixed DOF offsets interpreted as anatomical angles without model mapping.
Root-frame force/COP vectors assigned anatomical directions/legs.
Rotation-matrix coefficient labelled as angle in radians.
One million-frame read could be out of bounds or truncate source.
Exceptions silently dropped frames and shortened elapsed time.
Trials grouped only by task before segmentation.
Opposite-leg phase invented by 50 percent shift; phase rate lacked physical time.
Missing values interpolated across gaps; event end frame excluded; no complete exclusion accounting.
replacement_behavior: Preserve original B3D bytes in place and bind SHA256. Export all public source-frame and per-pass properties with array dtype/shape, nested values and explicit nonfinite tokens. Unknown property types fail loudly and leave an incomplete manifest.

Write separate per-file source Parquet, one raw-frame row and every actual pass row per frame, plus every embedded global-pass model XML and source header/contact-body metadata. Local pass slot is not assumed to identify a global model.
Use exact source trial length, 32-frame reads, 4 MiB single payload and 32 MiB accumulated batch limits. Stream output; no whole-dataset concatenation.
Keep exact trial/name/split/frame/file identifiers and original timestep. Time is trial-local frame index times timestep, not reconstructed global session time.
Retain invalid/missing source mass and availability flag; do not normalize any unsupported channel.

Do not automatically generate canonical anatomical or phase outputs. Optional standalone phase helper requires reviewed external force mapping, one source recording, finite clock and inclusive endpoints.
All source files have pending/running/completed disposition. Errors retain partial artifacts and mark stopped_incomplete, not successful conversion.
Canonical task stays null for all source-only rows. Historical task predictions are retained only as explicitly unreviewed metadata, separate from original trial names.
breaking_behavior: Fresh output directory is mandatory. Output is source-preservation Parquet plus model/metadata files rather than guessed canonical time/phase tables. It is a prerequisite for corrected canonical reconstruction, not completion of that objective. Existing historical artifacts remain unchanged.
source_json_encoding: source_fields_json is ordinary JSON. Arrays retain dtype, shape and numeric values; NaN/Infinity use explicit source_nonfinite objects. Floating signed zero is retained. Original B3D remains the authoritative byte source; NaN payload bits are not reinterpreted as scientific values.

cases: Variable 1/3 pass counts and unexpected DOF ordering
All exposed metadata including custom channels, raw force plates, markers and missing-GRF flags
Exact 65-frame batch boundaries and separate repeated-task trial identity
Short/misindexed/unsupported frame failures without time shrinkage
Physical phase rate and unavailable opposite-leg phase
Persisted Parquet counts, embedded model text, retained original file and overwrite rejection
Failure ledger includes unstarted source files
Variable per-frame pass availability explicitly compared to trial header without deleting frames
Startup WSL reserve and output-disk reserve refusal
Runtime guard breach retains incomplete source-file ledger
Historical task guesses never populate the source-only canonical task column; original trial name remains task_id.

remaining_gates: No real B3D arrays loaded; a reviewed single-file guarded pilot must verify installed native API/property types and actual on-disk source values independently.
Expose/model-bind DOF names, axis signs, contact-body identities and participant versus fitted model mass before canonical reconstruction.
Independent persisted original-B3D readback is still required; current mock tests do not prove real dataset correctness.
Source header APIs requiring full arrays are not automatically loaded; their omission is explicit in loss ledger and original B3D is retained.
Cross-file participant identity, historical dataset attribution, trial task mappings, source version/license and source-quality interpretation remain dataset-specific admission gates.

resource_guards.note: Startup check precedes native reader import; periodic checks occur during hashing, bounded reads and writes. Actual execution still requires coordinator single-worker scheduling.
